_about: What each designed site looks like, for scripts/check-fingerprints.mjs (Tzvi, 19 Oct 2026: businesses must not come out too similar). Fonts and colours are read from the pages; these six are written by hand when a site is built. own_colours: colours taken from the business's own logo or menu, which never count as a clash. effects: one id per kind from _effects (rules 3p.4); shared effects between two sites may total 2 points, a loud one counting 2. A pinned or scrubbed scene is a technique, not an effect: what it shows is the signature.

B3.name: circle grows to fill, label swaps

B6.name: arrow swap: out right, a new one in from the left

T8.name: lifts a little, border or shadow changes

T9.name: colour wash wipes in from the side

S8.name: cards slide over a fixed photo

chicken-munch.hero: giant word with their real product cut out and dropped across it
chicken-munch.signature: letters spread and the product rises on scroll; stickers with real facts
chicken-munch.nav: dark bar, wordmark, pages, outline order button
chicken-munch.close: dark band with contacts and a giant two-colour wordmark

whipped-cup.hero: their sunniest real photo full screen, headline over the shaded side
whipped-cup.signature: walk in the clouds: a cloud-shaped window opens on her iced coffee and grows to fill the screen; a servings switch says how many jars

whipped-cup.close: chocolate band with a giant serif name
